The night before an important product release deadline, the boss asked two of their subordinates, a 50-year-old and a 22-year-old, to stay late to continue working. The 50-year-old was too tired to stay but the 22-year-old continued to work for several more hours. Who was not willing to work more?
A. Undetermined
B. The 50-year-old
C. The 22-year-old
